load_requirement: sys.path must include the project's src/ directory before joblib.load(), because the pickled Pipeline references the FeatureEngineer class defined in src/p3_pipeline.py by module name.

input.format: pandas.DataFrame, one row per customer, or an equivalent list-of-records JSON payload
optional_columns: customerID (passthrough identifier, not used by the model)

TotalCharges.dtype: string (numeric, may be blank/whitespace for tenure==0 new customers -> coerced to null then imputed)

notes: TotalCharges MUST be pre-coerced to numeric float (NaN for blanks) by the CALLER before scoring -- the pipeline's FeatureEngineer checks TotalCharges.isna() to detect the 11 tenure==0 blank-string rows, and .isna() is a no-op on a string column, so passing the true raw (string, blank-for-new-customers) CSV column unmodified will raise a TypeError at the avg_monthly_spend division step. Confirmed by direct test: `pd.to_numeric(df['TotalCharges'].astype(str).str.strip(), errors='coerce')` must run first. This corrects an earlier draft of this contract that assumed the pipeline did this coercion internally -- it does not.

All OTHER cleaning and feature construction (sentinel collapsing, engineered features) happens inside the pipeline once TotalCharges is numeric. Feed raw-schema columns otherwise -- do not pre-engineer features.

output.predict_proba: float in [0,1], calibrated probability of churn (class 1)
output.decision_rule: flag as at-risk if predict_proba >= chosen_threshold (calibrated for ~50% retention-team contact capacity, see model_card.md)
